extensionName.description: User-visible product name. Single source of the literal; read by shared/constants.js via chrome.i18n.getMessage('extensionName'). Kept SHORT because it is interpolated into report copy (e.g. 'Salvage found your library: ...'). The keyword-bearing Chrome Web Store listing title is a separate concern — see extensionListingTitle and BRAND-PACK.md §12.

extensionListingTitle.message: Salvage — Clean Up Duplicate & Broken Bookmarks
extensionListingTitle.description: Keyword-bearing name shown in the Chrome Web Store listing only (per PRD.md §24). Carried by the manifest 'name' field via __MSG_extensionListingTitle__, so the store sees the SEO title while the extension UI and report copy keep the short form (extensionName → 'Salvage'). Distinct from, and served in place of, the short product name at the store surface only.

extensionDescription.message: Find the duplicates, dead links and forgotten folders in the bookmark library you already have. Nothing is deleted without your say-so, and everything is recoverable.
extensionDescription.description: User-visible long description shown on the extension store/management surface. Leads with cleanup keywords per PRD.md §24, and with the recovery guarantee, which is a checkable advantage over the incumbent.
